answers.explanation: SCPs apply to all principals in member accounts — even AdministratorAccess cannot override an explicit SCP Deny. Night 1 miss.
RAM shares resources (subnets, TGW) across accounts. Identity Center is SSO, not resource sharing. Night 1 miss.
IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) federates workforce users to AWS accounts and SaaS apps. Cognito is for customer-facing apps.
Fargate pulls images and writes logs via the task execution role, not the task role. Night 1 lab topic.
NACLs are stateless — you must allow return traffic on ephemeral ports. Security groups are stateful. Night 1 topic.
Cross-account KMS requires both key policy trust and IAM permissions on the caller. Night 2 miss.
S3 Bucket Key reduces KMS API calls by using a bucket-level key for SSE-KMS. Night 2 miss.
Secrets Manager stores credentials with optional automatic rotation. Parameter Store String has no rotation.
KMS = keys. Secrets Manager = secret values. Night 3 miss.
ACM certificates for CloudFront must be in us-east-1. ALB certs use the Region of the load balancer.
ALB/API Gateway use REGIONAL scope. CloudFront uses CLOUDFRONT scope in us-east-1. Night 4 miss.
Shield Standard covers L3/L4 DDoS free on CloudFront. WAF handles L7 (SQLi, XSS). Night 4 lab.
Network Firewall filters VPC traffic between subnets. WAF is for HTTP at the edge/ALB. Night 4 miss.
Firewall Manager deploys WAF rules org-wide. Night 4 miss.
CloudTrail = API audit log with who/when/what.
Log file validation provides digest hashes for tamper detection. Not the same as data events. Night 5 miss.
Config rules evaluate current resource configuration state continuously.
GuardDuty ML threat detection from CloudTrail, VPC Flow, DNS logs.
Access Analyzer evaluates resource policies for external/cross-account access paths.
Session Manager provides shell access without inbound SSH. Night 3 SSM contrast.
Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in S3. Week 1 awareness gap.
NON_COMPLIANT ≠ incident. Public bucket + CloudFront works but fails the rule; OAC is the modern fix.
Night 3 lab pattern: Secrets Manager + scoped IAM + kms:Decrypt on the CMK.
Control Tower = multi-account landing zone with guardrails. Week 1 awareness gap.
Config charges ~$2-5/mo recording all resources. CloudTrail first trail is free; teardown script keeps it.
